entry.title: Winston Churchill Petite Panatela — Tin of 5
experienceTags: Occasion: Short premium smoke, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Wood, chocolate, coffee, warm spice and dried-fruit sweetness are the projected centre of this compact Winston Churchill. The Original Series uses an Ecuadorian Habano Rojiza wrapper over a Mexican San Andrés Oscuro binder and Dominican/Nicaraguan filler, giving it more savoury spice and structure than Davidoff's gentlest lines without pushing into Late Hour territory. The handmade 4″ × 38 format is substantial enough for a cooler, denser short smoke while remaining genuinely compact.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. CigarWorld currently lists the five-cigar tin at A$139 (A$27.80 each) and an exact single at A$28.95, so the single provides a low-commitment test. Strength and Quality are provisional and Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
